sloka: ताम् महा उल्काम् इव आकाशे दीप्यमानाम् स्व तेजसा ।जहार आकाशम् आविश्य सीताम् वैश्रवण अनुजः ॥३-५२-३१॥
transliteration: tām mahā ulkām iva ākāśe dīpyamānām sva tejasā ।jahāra ākāśam āviśya sītām vaiśravaṇa anujaḥ ॥3-52-31॥

translations.english: The younger brother of Vaisravana (Ravana), like a massive comet, carried Sita, who was glowing in the radiance of her own beauty, and entered the sky.
